name: Test: FNA layer cost (C#)
author: test
summary: Nanoseconds and bytes per operation for the FNA API on the phone: the game's math statics through the bridge, the hand-written operators and equality, the bounding math, effects, SaveAsPng, DrawString and SpriteBatch.Begin, each next to a plain C# reference.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csfnaperf. In the world, one case per frame; logs 'csfnaperf <case> <ns> ns/op <bytes> B/op n=<n>' and 'csfnaperf END cases=N'.
